description: This file defines types, enums, and function prototypes for managing serialized device data, error codes, image upgrades, and splash screen handling in a device management framework, specifically for unit testing stubs related to 'mfr' (manufacturer) types.

methods.name: mfr_init
methods.description: Initializes the manufacturer framework library; should be called once before other functions.

methods.name: mfr_partition_init
methods.description: Initializes the manufacturer partition; should be called before accessing serialized data.

methods.name: mfrGetSerializedData
methods.description: Retrieves serialized read-only data from the device based on specified type.

methods.name: mfrSetSerializedData
methods.description: Sets serialized read/write data on the device for a specified type.

methods.name: mfrWriteImage
methods.description: Writes an image to flash memory, following steps for flashing, updating boot params, and switching banks.

methods.name: mfrDeletePDRI
methods.description: Deletes the P-DRI image if present.

methods.name: mfrScrubAllBanks
methods.description: Deletes all platform images from flash.

methods.name: mfrSetBootloaderPattern
methods.description: Sets the behavior pattern of front panel LEDs and backlight during bootloader mode.

methods.name: mfrSetBlSplashScreen
methods.description: Updates the primary splash screen image with a specified file.

methods.name: mfrClearBlSplashScreen
methods.description: Resets to default splash screen image, clearing any custom image.
